section_summary.extract_value: This is a Portuguese abstract describing a single study that tested a path model examining the relationship between early positive memories and eating psychopathology in a sample of 490 women. The study found that social safeness and body appreciation (apreciação corporal) mediated the impact of early warm memories on disordered eating behavior, with the model explaining 51% of the variance in eating psychopathology while controlling for BMI.
